cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
if(CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR STREQUAL CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR)
  project(LMX_Science_Extra LANGUAGES C)
endif()
if(NOT DEFINED LMX_VENDOR_DIR)
  get_filename_component(LMX_VENDOR_DIR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/../../vendor" ABSOLUTE)
endif()
option(LMX_SCIENCE_EXTRA_BUILD_TESTS "Build offline science checks" OFF)

function(lmx_science_c99 target)
  set_target_properties(${target} PROPERTIES C_STANDARD 99 C_STANDARD_REQUIRED YES C_EXTENSIONS NO)
  if(CMAKE_C_COMPILER_ID MATCHES "GNU|Clang")
    target_compile_options(${target} PRIVATE -pedantic-errors)
  endif()
endfunction()

include("${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/prepare_lsoda.cmake")
lmx_prepare_lsoda("${LMX_VENDOR_DIR}/liblsoda/src" "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/lsoda_c99")
set(lsoda_sources cfode.c cfode_static.c common.c corfailure.c correction.c
    daxpy.c ddot.c dgefa.c dgesl.c dscal.c fnorm.c idamax.c intdy.c lsoda.c
    methodswitch.c orderswitch.c prja.c scaleh.c solsy.c stoda.c vmnorm.c
    strdup_printf.c)
list(TRANSFORM lsoda_sources PREPEND "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/lsoda_c99/")
add_library(lmx_lsoda STATIC ${lsoda_sources})
add_library(LMX::lsoda ALIAS lmx_lsoda)
target_include_directories(lmx_lsoda PUBLIC "${LMX_VENDOR_DIR}/liblsoda/src")
lmx_science_c99(lmx_lsoda)

file(GLOB erfa_sources CONFIGURE_DEPENDS "${LMX_VENDOR_DIR}/erfa/src/*.c")
list(FILTER erfa_sources EXCLUDE REGEX "/t_erfa_c(_extra)?\\.c$")
add_library(lmx_erfa STATIC ${erfa_sources})
add_library(LMX::erfa ALIAS lmx_erfa)
target_include_directories(lmx_erfa PUBLIC "${LMX_VENDOR_DIR}/erfa/src")
target_compile_definitions(lmx_erfa PRIVATE PACKAGE_VERSION="2.0.1"
  PACKAGE_VERSION_MAJOR=2 PACKAGE_VERSION_MINOR=0 PACKAGE_VERSION_MICRO=1
  SOFA_VERSION="20231011")
lmx_science_c99(lmx_erfa)
if(NOT WIN32)
  target_link_libraries(lmx_lsoda PUBLIC m)
  target_link_libraries(lmx_erfa PUBLIC m)
endif()
add_library(lmx_science_extra INTERFACE)
add_library(LMX::science_extra ALIAS lmx_science_extra)
target_link_libraries(lmx_science_extra INTERFACE LMX::lsoda LMX::erfa)

if(LMX_SCIENCE_EXTRA_BUILD_TESTS)
  enable_testing()
  add_executable(lmx_test_lsoda tests/test_lsoda.c)
  target_link_libraries(lmx_test_lsoda PRIVATE LMX::lsoda)
  lmx_science_c99(lmx_test_lsoda)
  add_test(NAME science.lsoda COMMAND lmx_test_lsoda)
  foreach(suite IN ITEMS t_erfa_c t_erfa_c_extra)
    add_executable(lmx_${suite} "${LMX_VENDOR_DIR}/erfa/src/${suite}.c")
    target_link_libraries(lmx_${suite} PRIVATE LMX::erfa)
    lmx_science_c99(lmx_${suite})
    add_test(NAME science.${suite} COMMAND lmx_${suite})
  endforeach()
endif()
